title: Variations on Majorization of Vectors and Connections to Determinantal Inequalities
summary: Majorization is a fundamental tool for comparing vectors, with connections to convexity, doubly stochastic matrices, eigenvalues, singular values, and zeros of polynomials. In matrix analysis, it plays a central role in the study of eigenvalue inequalities, particularly those arising from classical determinantal inequalities such as those attributed to Hadamard and Fischer in the context of positive semidefinite matrices.
